```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
save_plot = function(plot, file, legend = TRUE, width = 4, height = 4, png = FALSE, svg = FALSE) {
  if (png) { ggsave(plot = plot, filename =  paste0(file, ".png"), dpi = 600, width = ifelse(legend, width, width - 1.5), height = height, units = 'in') }
  if (svg) { ggsave(plot = plot, filename =  paste0(file, ".svg"), dpi = 600, width = ifelse(legend, width, width - 1.5), height = height, units = 'in') }
  ggsave(plot = plot, filename =  paste0(file, ".pdf"), dpi = 600, width = ifelse(legend, width, width - 1.5), height = height, units = 'in')
}
```

# Prepare PBMC data.
```{r}
seu_pbmcs_annotated = readRDS("rds_objects/6_pbmcs_harmonized.rds")
seu_pbmcs_annotated$CHIP[seu_pbmcs_annotated$Patient_ID == "CH-21-006"] = "DNMT3A"
seu_pbmcs_annotated$CHIP[seu_pbmcs_annotated$Patient_ID == "CH-21-014"] = "TET2"
seu_pbmcs_annotated$CHIP[seu_pbmcs_annotated$CHIP == "control"] = "Control"

```

# Prepare monocytes.
```{r}
cd14_monos = subset(seu_pbmcs_annotated, subset = (cell_type == "Classical Monocytes"))
```

# Collect endothelial cells.
```{r}
census = open_soma(census_version = "2023-07-25")

# Open obs SOMADataFrame
cell_metadata = census$get("census_data")$get("homo_sapiens")$get("obs")

# Read as Arrow Table
cell_metadata = cell_metadata$read(
   value_filter = "cell_type %in% c('endothelial cell') & assay %in% c('10x 3\\' v3') & disease %in% c('normal')",
   column_names = c("assay", "cell_type", "tissue", "tissue_general", "suspension_type", "disease"),
)

# Concatenates results to an Arrow Table
cell_metadata = cell_metadata$concat() %>% as.data.frame()

seurat_obj_2 = get_seurat(
   census = census,
   organism = "Homo sapiens",
   obs_value_filter = "cell_type %in% c('endothelial cell') & assay %in% c('10x 3\\' v3') & disease %in% c('normal')",
   obs_column_names = c("assay", "cell_type", "tissue", "tissue_general", "suspension_type", "disease")
)

rownames(seurat_obj_2@assays$RNA@counts) = seurat_obj_2@assays$RNA@meta.features$feature_name
rownames(seurat_obj_2@assays$RNA@data) = seurat_obj_2@assays$RNA@meta.features$feature_name
  
saveRDS(seurat_obj_2, "rds_objects/czi/endo_sample_2.rds")
```

# Prepare endothelial cells.
```{r}
endo_sample_2 = readRDS("rds_objects/czi/endo_sample_2.rds")
tissues_of_interest = c("trachea", "spleen", "endometrium", "liver", "adipose tissue", "kidney", "subcutaneous adipose tissue", "visceral abdominal adipose tissue", "vasculature", "eye trabecular meshwork", "spinal cord", "lung", "heart right ventricle", "heart left ventricle", "aorta")
endo_sample_2 = subset(endo_sample_2, subset = tissue %in% tissues_of_interest)

Idents(endo_sample_2) = "tissue"
endo_sample_2 = subset(endo_sample_2, downsample = 645)

tet2_endo_sample_2 = endo_sample_2
tet2_endo_sample_2$CHIP = "TET2"
dnmt3a_endo_sample_2 = endo_sample_2
dnmt3a_endo_sample_2$CHIP = "DNMT3A"
control_endo_sample_2 = endo_sample_2
control_endo_sample_2$CHIP = "Control"


```



# Function to create objects.
```{r}
create_cc = function(seu_obj, output_path, nPatterns = 5) {
  # Follow steps from tutorial.
  cellchat = createCellChat(object = seu_obj, meta = seu_obj@meta.data, group.by = "tissue") 
  cellchat@DB = CellChatDB.human
  
  # Preprocessing.
  cellchat = subsetData(cellchat)
  cellchat = identifyOverExpressedGenes(cellchat)
  cellchat = identifyOverExpressedInteractions(cellchat)
  cellchat = projectData(cellchat, PPI.human) 
  cellchat = computeCommunProb(cellchat, type = "truncatedMean", trim = 0.1, distance.use = FALSE) 
  
  # Filter out the cell-cell communication if there are only few number of cells in certain cell groups 
  cellchat = filterCommunication(cellchat, min.cells = 25) 
  cellchat = computeCommunProbPathway(cellchat) 
  cellchat = aggregateNet(cellchat) 
  saveRDS(cellchat, output_path)
  return(cellchat)
}
```

# Combine monocytes and endothelial cells.
```{r}
mono_czi_endo = merge(cd14_monos, y = c(tet2_endo_sample_2, dnmt3a_endo_sample_2, control_endo_sample_2), add.cell.ids = c("monos", "TET2_endos", "DNMT3A_endos", "Control_endos"))
mono_czi_endo$tissue = ifelse(!is.na(mono_czi_endo$tissue), mono_czi_endo$tissue, mono_czi_endo$cell_type)

mono_czi_endo = SCTransform(mono_czi_endo)
```

# Create cellchat objects.
```{r}
mono_czi_endo.list = SplitObject(mono_czi_endo, split.by = "CHIP")

mono_czi_endo_tet2 = mono_czi_endo.list$TET2
mono_czi_endo_dnmt3a = mono_czi_endo.list$DNMT3A
mono_czi_endo_control = mono_czi_endo.list$Control

create_cc(mono_czi_endo_tet2, "rds_objects/cellchat/mono_czi_endo_tet2_cc.rds")
create_cc(mono_czi_endo_dnmt3a, "rds_objects/cellchat/mono_czi_endo_dnmt3a_cc.rds")
create_cc(mono_czi_endo_control, "rds_objects/cellchat/mono_czi_endo_control_cc.rds")

```


# Load objects.
```{r}
mono_czi_endo_tet2_cc = readRDS("rds_objects/cellchat/mono_czi_endo_tet2_cc.rds")
mono_czi_endo_dnmt3a_cc = readRDS("rds_objects/cellchat/mono_czi_endo_dnmt3a_cc.rds")
mono_czi_endo_control_cc = readRDS("rds_objects/cellchat/mono_czi_endo_control_cc.rds")
```

# Merge objects.
```{r}
mono_czi_endo_cc.list = list(TET2 = mono_czi_endo_tet2_cc, DNMT3A = mono_czi_endo_dnmt3a_cc, Control = mono_czi_endo_control_cc)
mono_czi_endo_cc = mergeCellChat(mono_czi_endo_cc.list, add.names = names(mono_czi_endo_cc.list))
mono_czi_endo_cc = updateCellChat(mono_czi_endo_cc)
```

```{r}

tissues = c("trachea", "spleen", "vasculature", "endometrium", "liver", "adipose tissue", "kidney", "visceral abdominal adipose tissue", "spinal cord", "lung", "eye trabecular meshwork", "heart right ventricle", "heart left ventricle", "subcutaneous adipose tissue", "aorta")

for (tissue in tissues) {
  tissue_grouped_rank = rankNet(mono_czi_endo_cc, mode = "comparison", comparison = c(1, 2, 3), sources.use = c("Classical Monocytes", tissue), targets.use = c("Classical Monocytes", tissue), signaling = c("CCL", "ICAM", "VCAM", "SELPLG", "CXCL", "SELL", "ITGB2", "PECAM1"), do.stat = TRUE, color.use = c("#3E7274",  "#584482", "grey"), title = tissue) + aes(x = contribution.scaled, y = name) + ylab("") + xlab("Signaling strength") + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  save_plot(tissue_grouped_rank, paste0("figures/cellchat/tissue_", tissue, "_grouped_rank"), width = 4, height = 3, png = TRUE)
  print(tissue_grouped_rank)
}
```
